stem: In a febrile 8-week-old infant, what guides the threshold for sepsis workup in the 4-12 week age group?

options.text: Whether there is a weekend review available

explanation: Clinical appearance and history guide the threshold for sepsis workup in febrile infants aged 4-12 weeks.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because the threshold for sepsis workup in 4-12 week infants is guided by clinical appearance and history.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because fever alone is not the stated determinant of the workup threshold in this age group.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because the time the fever started is not the criterion used to set the threshold.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because family preference does not determine whether a sepsis workup is indicated.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because weekend review availability is not part of the clinical threshold for workup.
